name: Smile Dog
description: Smile Dog (also written Smile.jpg) is an image-based creepypasta about an allegedly cursed photograph of a husky-like dog with human-style teeth. The accompanying short story is most often attributed to Michael Lutz, who posted a canonical version to the Creepypasta Wiki in August 2010.
origin: An internet-native fiction: distribution is anywhere the anglophone internet reaches. The originating community is North American imageboard culture (4chan) and the wider Creepypasta Wiki community.
